mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of statin-related myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, particularly with simvastatin's potent CYP3A4 metabolism.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider alternative statin with less CYP3A4 dependence (pravastatin or rosuvastatin) or ensure electrolyte supplementation if combination necessary.
